messages.quest.hearthbound.first_fire.description: Help a cook gather the first shared hearth supplies for the village.
quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: A village does not become steady because one person eats well. It becomes steady when there is a warm place people trust.
Bring a campfire, 6 charcoal, 6 bowls, and 6 cooked cod. That will give the first fire both a place and a purpose.
messages.quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: I will help set the hearth.
quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: The first fire still needs a campfire, charcoal, bowls, and cooked cod. The list will not change before the hearth is ready.
messages.quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: Bring 6 bowls for the first shared meal.
Bring 1 campfire for the shared hearth.
The fire has enough clean fuel.
Bring 6 charcoal so the first fire burns clean.
Bring 6 cooked cod to fill the first pots.
quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: Fair enough. A cold pot can wait, but it never waits kindly.
Keep the charcoal dry. Damp fuel makes everyone pretend not to complain.
Bring 1 campfire, 6 charcoal, 6 bowls, and 6 cooked cod for the shared hearth.
I do not have that hearth note open right now.
The first fire is already warming the village.
Good. Bring 1 campfire, 6 charcoal, 6 bowls, and 6 cooked cod. That is the complete list for this hearth.
The hearth is not ready to ask for help right now.
messages.quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.kindl: Bring 1 campfire, 6 charcoal, 6 bowls, and 6 cooked cod.
quest.hearthbound.first_fire.stage.retur: Fire, bowls, and food. That is enough to make a room feel less temporary.
There. The first fire is not much to look at yet, but people will stand closer to it than they admit.
The hearth still needs its campfire, charcoal, bowls, or cooked fish before we light it.
Bring the hearth supplies here before we set anything down.
I cannot close the hearth note right now.
Bring everything together. Scattered comfort is still scattered.
messages.quest.hearthbound.first_fire.title: Kindling
